fusions.name: Rearing Wheel
fusions.desc: Wheels the blade in a full circle that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 20 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Tempo
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 12 seconds. For 5 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Ride-By Cut
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a cut strikes the nearest enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
